verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents some narrow rule-driven automation. The Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler scales Node Pools automatically in response to GPU, CPU, or memory demand. AI Object Storage lifecycle policies run defined actions such as Expiration and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload. However, the evidence shows no general-purpose way to define custom rules that fire actions on platform events. missing for 10: general event-rule/trigger engine, webhooks or event notifications, user-defined custom actions on arbitrary events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
